proof.oneVariable: Let lower ordinate be t. Upper ordinate is t+d; substitute into the inverse relation to get the one-variable equation p(t+d)=q t. All p,q,d are printed numerical constants.
proof.unique: The coefficient q-p=d is positive, so the single linear equation has exactly one solution.
